title: 【もしも歴史】刀に「心」があったら｜刀狩の夜、1本だけ家に帰った刀の世界線
promise: 1588年の刀狩令の中身、同じころの検地帳、集めた刀の行き先だった方広寺の大仏のその後、そして『村に刀は残ったのに、刀を差して歩く百姓は消えた』理由が、1本で分かる
desc:
もしも刀に心があったら。1588年の刀狩で差し出された百姓の刀が1本、夜のうちに持ち主の家へ帰ったら。刀は帰れた。それでも刀狩は、ちゃんと効いていた。刀狩令が本当に取り上げた物は何だったのか。集めた刀を釘にするはずだった大仏は、どうなったのか。

あなたなら、どこで歴史を変える？ コメントで教えてください。

※刀に心があり、刀どうしで話し、夜に動いて家へ帰る話、古い刀が賤ヶ岳や小牧・長久手の戦に出ていたという刀の思い出話と、持ち主の百姓とその村は作り話です。刀狩令（1588年）の中身・原本の大きさ・加賀江沼郡で集めた武器の数・肥後国衆一揆・太閤検地・賤ヶ岳の戦い・小牧長久手の戦い・方広寺の大仏と跡地・廃刀令などは、日本大百科全書・世界大百科事典・デジタル大辞泉（コトバンク）、東京大学、文化遺産オンライン、京都市の年表、文化庁の国指定文化財等データベース、国立国会図書館の法令データベースなどをもとにしています。肥後の細川忠利の命令（1633年）・尾張藩の大刀と大脇差の禁止（1642年）・百姓一揆で武器を持ち出した割合は、藤木久志『刀狩り 武器を封印した民衆』（岩波新書）の紹介をもとにしています（大仏の完成の年や高さには諸説あります）。
※映像とナレーションはAIを使って作っています。
world_rules: 刀には心がある。刀は考え、刀どうしでだけ話せる。人には刀の声は聞こえない（持ち主にも、役人にも、秀吉にも）
刀は夜のあいだだけ、少しずつ自分で動ける。人が見ている時は動かない
刀が知っているのは、自分の身に起きたこと・自分のいる場で見聞きしたこと（村で役人が持ち主の名を帳面に書いたこと・村での命令の読み上げ）・ほかの刀から聞いたことだけ。先のこと（大仏・廃刀令など）や、刀のいない所の出来事（全国の検地帳のしくみ・肥後の一揆・原本の大きさ）は知らない。それは語り手が話す
持ち主は、刀が自分で帰ったことを知らない。誰かが返しに来たとしか思えない
長持にしまわれた後の刀が知るのは、長持の中で聞こえる村の人の話し声と足音だけ（細川忠利の命令・尾張藩・一揆の数は知らない。それは語り手が話す）
刀の世界線で変わるのは、1本の刀が刀の山から持ち主の家へ帰ることだけ。年・人・出来事（刀狩令・集めた数・肥後の一揆・検地・賤ヶ岳・小牧長久手・細川忠利の命令・尾張藩の禁止・大仏・廃刀令）は本当の歴史
facts: 刀狩令：天正16年7月8日（1588年）に出た3か条。1条＝諸国の百姓が刀・脇差・弓・槍・鉄砲などを持つことを禁じ、すべて差し出させる。2条＝集めた武器は大仏の釘・かすがいに使う（来世までの功徳になると説いた）。3条＝百姓は農具さえ持ち耕作に専念すれば子々孫々まで長久。出どころ：日本大百科全書・改訂新版 世界大百科事典「刀狩」（コトバンク kotobank.jp/word/刀狩-44956、刀狩-117329）

肥後国衆一揆：1587年、九州平定後に肥後を与えられた佐々成政が検地を強引に進め、国衆が反発して一揆。秀吉が動員した諸将で鎮圧。成政は責任を問われ、1588年（天正16年5月14日）に切腹。刀狩令（7月8日）まで2か月足らず。出どころ：文化遺産オンライン 田中城跡 online.bunka.go.jp/heritages/detail/164521、熊本市の資料 www.city.kumamoto.jp/kiji00361089/
原本：国宝『島津家文書』の『豊臣秀吉掟書・刀狩令』を東京大学史料編纂所が所蔵。大高檀紙、縦48.2cm・横130.2cm、同時期の信長の文書の1.5倍ほど。秀吉が権威をどう示そうとしたかを伝える史料。出どころ：東京大学 www.u-tokyo.ac.jp/focus/ja/features/z0508_00150.html
集めた数：加賀江沼郡の武具請取状（発令の約40日後）に刀1073腰・脇差1540腰・鑓160本・笄500本・小刀700（日本大百科全書。合計3973）。溝口秀勝の領国では1か月ほどで刀・脇差など約4000点（世界大百科事典）。出どころ：コトバンク「刀狩」
賤ヶ岳の戦い：1583年（天正11年）4月、近江国の賤ヶ岳付近で羽柴（豊臣）秀吉が柴田勝家を破った。出どころ：コトバンク「賤ヶ岳の戦」
小牧・長久手の戦い：1584年（天正12年）、尾張国の小牧・長久手付近で、羽柴秀吉と徳川家康・織田信雄の連合軍が戦った。決定的な勝敗はつかず和睦。出どころ：コトバンク「小牧・長久手の戦い」
太閤検地：豊臣秀吉が天正10年（1582）から全国で行った検地。耕地1筆ごとに耕作者を検地帳に記載して年貢負担者を確定した（デジタル大辞泉）。検地帳には耕地一筆ごとに1人の耕作者名が記載（山川日本史小辞典）。兵農分離の基礎になった（日本大百科全書）。出どころ：コトバンク「太閤検地」 kotobank.jp/word/太閤検地
例外と実際：民間の武器が絶滅した事実はなく、本質は身分制の確立策。特定の町人の刀所持、神事での貸与、猪・鹿の駆除のための槍（10本の許可の例）などが認められた。17世紀前半までは百姓・町人の刀・脇差の所持が禁じられた形跡は無い。出どころ：日本大百科全書「刀狩」（コトバンク）。※槍10本・神事の例は地名・年が読めた範囲に無いので台本では使わない

刀狩のあとの村の武器（藤木久志『刀狩り 武器を封印した民衆』岩波新書 2005年。岩波書店 www.iwanami.co.jp/book/b268784.html）：1633年（寛永10年）肥後で細川忠利が、庄屋に刀と脇差、百姓に脇差の所持を命じ、持たない者には過料を科した（細川忠利は加藤忠広の改易のあと小倉から肥後へ移った）。1642年（寛永19年）尾張藩が町人・百姓の大刀・大脇差を禁じた。出どころ：同書の書評（www.fben.jp/bookcolumn/2005/12/28/955/）。江戸時代の百姓一揆約1430件のうち、百姓が武器を持ち出した例は約1%（同書の紹介 note.com/koritakada/n/n5e7df746860c）。台本では『藤木久志さんが本の『刀狩り』で紹介している』『〜だという』と、研究の紹介として言う
苗字帯刀：兵農分離・刀狩などで、帯刀は原則として武士身分の特権と制度的に確定。出どころ：世界大百科事典・日本大百科全書「苗字帯刀」（コトバンク kotobank.jp/word/苗字帯刀-139772）

方広寺の大仏：1586年に造営地を選び、工事の本格化は1588年以降。はじめ銅の計画が漆膠に改められ、木造に漆・金箔。高さ6丈（約18m）とも6丈3尺（約19m）とも。京都市の年表では1595年（文禄4）完成、1596年（慶長元）の大地震で倒壊。秀頼が再建し1612年に完成。その金銅大仏も1662年の地震で倒れ寛永通宝に改鋳。1798年に雷火で焼失。出どころ：京都市 都市史19 大仏殿 www2.city.kyoto.lg.jp/somu/rekishi/fm/nenpyou/htmlsheet/toshi19.html、コトバンク「方広寺」
慶長伏見地震：1596年（文禄5）9月5日に発生。伏見や京都での被害が注目される。出どころ：コトバンク「慶長伏見地震」
方広寺大仏殿跡及び石塁・石塔：京都市東山区茶屋町。1969年に国の史跡。旧寺域外周の巨石を連ねる石塁が指定。2000年の発掘調査などで大仏殿の基壇・礎石の据付穴・大仏の台座の石組みなどを確認。出どころ：文化庁 国指定文化財等データベース（文化遺産オンライン online.bunka.go.jp/heritages/detail/216869）
廃刀令：1876年（明治9年）3月28日、太政官布告第38号『大礼服並軍人警察官吏等制服着用ノ外帯刀禁止ノ件』。出どころ：国立国会図書館 日本法令索引 hourei.ndl.go.jp（lawId=0000000056）、コトバンク「廃刀令」
刀狩令から廃刀令までの年数 1876−1588＝288年（計算）。江戸時代（1603年の江戸幕府から1867年の大政奉還まで、約265年）より長い。賤ヶ岳（1583）・小牧長久手（1584）は刀狩令の4〜5年前（計算）
使わない：『秀吉が倒れた大仏に矢を放った』などの逸話、地震の時刻、刀から造った釘のゆくえ（記録を読めなかったので、問いのまま答えを言い切らない）
刀に心があること・刀どうしの会話・刀が夜に動いて家へ帰ること・持ち主の百姓とその家と村、刀が出た戦の話（どの刀が賤ヶ岳に出たか）は作り話

cuts.narration: 庭の百姓たちが、思わず自分の腰の刀に手をやった。
cuts.image_en: A samurai official reading a blank scroll aloud in a village square to a crowd of worried peasants, some of them touching the swords at their belts. Place the main person slightly right of center.
cuts.image: A samurai official reading a blank scroll aloud in a village square to a crowd of worried peasants, some of them touching the swords at their belts. Place the main person slightly right of center.

cuts.narration: 2つ目。集めた武器は、京都に建てる大仏の釘やかすがいに使う。
cuts.label: 2つ目 大仏の釘

cuts.narration: そうすれば百姓は、この世だけでなく、来世まで救われる、と命令は説いた。
cuts.image_en: Peasants kneeling and praying toward a giant golden Buddha statue glowing softly in a dim hall, incense smoke rising. Faded old-memory colors.
cuts.image: Peasants kneeling and praying toward a giant golden Buddha statue glowing softly in a dim hall, incense smoke rising. Faded old-memory colors.

cuts.narration: 村で読み上げられたこの命令を、わしは持ち主の腰で聞いていた。
わしが、大仏の釘に。
cuts.image_en: Close-up of the old plain uchigatana sword in a worn black scabbard hanging on a farmhouse wall, a cold blue shadow falling across it, a sense of dread. No people. Place the sword slightly right of center.
cuts.image: Close-up of the old plain uchigatana sword in a worn black scabbard hanging on a farmhouse wall, a cold blue shadow falling across it, a sense of dread. No people. Place the sword slightly right of center.

cuts.narration: 村に、役人がやって来た。庄屋の家の前に、刀が次々と積まれていく。
cuts.image_en: In front of a large village headman's farmhouse, samurai officials with brushes and blank ledgers watch as peasants line up and lay swords and spears onto a growing heap.
cuts.image: In front of a large village headman's farmhouse, samurai officials with brushes and blank ledgers watch as peasants line up and lay swords and spears onto a growing heap.

cuts.narration: 持ち主は、わしを古い布で包んだ。
cuts.image_en: Inside a dim farmhouse, the same lean peasant farmer in his thirties (sunburned face, short stubble, simple topknot, patched brown hemp kosode) slowly wrapping the old sword in a faded indigo cloth, his wife watching sadly. Place the main person slightly right of center.
cuts.image: Inside a dim farmhouse, the same lean peasant farmer in his thirties (sunburned face, short stubble, simple topknot, patched brown hemp kosode) slowly wrapping the old sword in a faded indigo cloth, his wife watching sadly. Place the main person slightly right of center.

cuts.narration: 何も言わずに、刀を役人に差し出した。手が、少しふるえていた。
cuts.image_en: the same lean peasant farmer in his thirties (sunburned face, short stubble, simple topknot, patched brown hemp kosode), kneeling and silently handing the cloth-wrapped sword to a samurai official, eyes cast down, lips pressed tight. Place the main person slightly right of center.
cuts.image: the same lean peasant farmer in his thirties (sunburned face, short stubble, simple topknot, patched brown hemp kosode), kneeling and silently handing the cloth-wrapped sword to a samurai official, eyes cast down, lips pressed tight. Place the main person slightly right of center.

cuts.narration: 役人は帳面に筆を走らせ、その包みを、刀の山の上へ置いた。
cuts.image_en: A stern samurai official in a dark kataginu writing quickly with a brush in a blank ledger, then laying an indigo cloth-wrapped sword on top of a heap of weapons in front of a village headman's farmhouse. No readable writing. Place the main person slightly right of center.
cuts.image: A stern samurai official in a dark kataginu writing quickly with a brush in a blank ledger, then laying an indigo cloth-wrapped sword on top of a heap of weapons in front of a village headman's farmhouse. No readable writing. Place the main person slightly right of center.

cuts.narration: おい。わしを置いていくのか。
cuts.image_en: Close-up of the old sword half unwrapped from its indigo cloth, lying on top of a heap of weapons, the farmer's back walking away in the blurred background. Place the sword slightly right of center.
cuts.image: Close-up of the old sword half unwrapped from its indigo cloth, lying on top of a heap of weapons, the farmer's back walking away in the blurred background. Place the sword slightly right of center.

cuts.narration: その声は、持ち主には届かない。持ち主は、一度もふり返らなかった。
cuts.image_en: the same lean peasant farmer in his thirties (sunburned face, short stubble, simple topknot, patched brown hemp kosode), walking home alone along a rice-field path at sunset, his belt empty, shoulders slumped. Place the main person slightly right of center.
cuts.image: the same lean peasant farmer in his thirties (sunburned face, short stubble, simple topknot, patched brown hemp kosode), walking home alone along a rice-field path at sunset, his belt empty, shoulders slumped. Place the main person slightly right of center.

cuts.narration: 夕方まで、刀の山は高くなり続けた。脇差も、槍も、鉄砲も。
cuts.image_en: Late afternoon in front of a large village headman's farmhouse: a tall heap of swords, short swords and spears growing higher as more peasants add their weapons one by one, samurai officials watching with blank ledgers.
cuts.image: Late afternoon in front of a large village headman's farmhouse: a tall heap of swords, short swords and spears growing higher as more peasants add their weapons one by one, samurai officials watching with blank ledgers.

cuts.narration: 加賀の江沼郡では、40日ほどで、刀や脇差など、およそ4000点が集まった。
cuts.tts_text: 加賀のえぬまぐんでは、40日ほどで、刀や脇差など、およそ4000点が集まった。
cuts.image_en: A huge pile of hundreds of swords stacked in a large storehouse, officials counting them with blank ledgers, lantern light.
cuts.label: 約4000点
cuts.image: A huge pile of hundreds of swords stacked in a large storehouse, officials counting them with blank ledgers, lantern light.

cuts.narration: この村の刀の山も、庄屋の家の軒に届きそうなほど高くなった。
cuts.tts_text: この村の刀の山も、庄屋の家ののきに届きそうなほど高くなった。
cuts.image_en: Late afternoon in front of a village headman's thatched farmhouse: a towering heap of swords, short swords and spears piled almost up to the edge of the thatched eaves, a small peasant on tiptoe placing one more sword on top, an indigo cloth-wrapped sword near the summit. Place the main person slightly right of center.
cuts.label: 軒に届く刀の山
cuts.image: Late afternoon in front of a village headman's thatched farmhouse: a towering heap of swords, short swords and spears piled almost up to the edge of the thatched eaves, a small peasant on tiptoe placing one more sword on top, an indigo cloth-wrapped sword near the summit. Place the main person slightly right of center.

cuts.narration: 日が沈む。その山のいちばん上で、1本だけ、包みの布がほどけていた。
cuts.image_en: Sunset in front of the village headman's farmhouse: the old plain uchigatana sword in its worn black scabbard, half wrapped in faded indigo cloth, lying alone on top of a huge heap of weapons, long red shadows, the road empty. No people. Place the sword slightly right of center.
cuts.image: Sunset in front of the village headman's farmhouse: the old plain uchigatana sword in its worn black scabbard, half wrapped in faded indigo cloth, lying alone on top of a huge heap of weapons, long red shadows, the road empty. No people. Place the sword slightly right of center.

cuts.narration: その夜。庄屋の蔵に積まれた刀の山で、ひそひそ声がした。
cuts.image_en: Night inside a village storehouse: a mountain of swords and spears lit by a thin beam of moonlight, a mysterious atmosphere as if the blades are murmuring. No people.
cuts.label: 刀の山
cuts.image: Night inside a village storehouse: a mountain of swords and spears lit by a thin beam of moonlight, a mysterious atmosphere as if the blades are murmuring. No people.

cuts.narration: 戦に出た刀たちが、口々に自分の戦を語りはじめた。
cuts.image_en: Close view of battle-worn swords in the moonlit heap: notched blades, cracked scabbards, faded silk cords, each looking proud and grim. No people.
cuts.image: Close view of battle-worn swords in the moonlit heap: notched blades, cracked scabbards, faded silk cords, each looking proud and grim. No people.

cuts.narration: 中でも、いちばん古い刀は、さやが割れ、刃は欠けだらけだった。
cuts.image_en: A very old long tachi sword with a deeply notched blade and a crumbling scabbard lying on top of the moonlit heap, the light catching its scars. No people. Place the sword slightly right of center.
cuts.image: A very old long tachi sword with a deeply notched blade and a crumbling scabbard lying on top of the moonlit heap, the light catching its scars. No people. Place the sword slightly right of center.

cuts.narration: その古い刀は、1583年、近江の賤ヶ岳の戦に出ていた。
cuts.tts_text: その古い刀は、1583年、おうみのしずがたけの戦に出ていた。
cuts.image_en: A faded memory of a battle on a steep mountain ridge above a lake in Omi: Japanese foot soldiers with spears and swords charging up the slope, plain banners without writing, dust and smoke. Faded old-memory colors.
cuts.label: 1583年 賤ヶ岳
cuts.image: A faded memory of a battle on a steep mountain ridge above a lake in Omi: Japanese foot soldiers with spears and swords charging up the slope, plain banners without writing, dust and smoke. Faded old-memory colors.

cuts.narration: 秀吉が柴田勝家を破った戦だ。わしは、湖の上の尾根で槍を受けた。
cuts.tts_text: 秀吉がしばたかついえを破った戦だ。わしは、湖の上の尾根で槍を受けた。
cuts.image_en: A faded memory on a steep mountain ridge high above a calm lake: a battered long tachi sword clashing against an enemy spear shaft, splinters flying, foot soldiers with plain banners without writing struggling on the slope, no blood. Faded old-memory colors.
cuts.image: A faded memory on a steep mountain ridge high above a calm lake: a battered long tachi sword clashing against an enemy spear shaft, splinters flying, foot soldiers with plain banners without writing struggling on the slope, no blood. Faded old-memory colors.

cuts.narration: ガンと、つかの奥まで響いた。あの重さは、今も刃に残っている。
cuts.image_en: Extreme close-up of the very old long tachi sword in the moonlit storehouse heap, the deep notches along its blade catching the light, a faint tremor in the air as if it were remembering a heavy blow. No people. Place the sword slightly right of center.
cuts.image: Extreme close-up of the very old long tachi sword in the moonlit storehouse heap, the deep notches along its blade catching the light, a faint tremor in the air as if it were remembering a heavy blow. No people. Place the sword slightly right of center.

cuts.narration: 別の刀は、1584年、尾張の小牧・長久手の戦に出ていた。
cuts.tts_text: 別の刀は、1584年、おわりのこまき、ながくての戦に出ていた。
cuts.image_en: A faded memory of a battle on a wide plain in Owari: armored horsemen and foot soldiers clashing among low hills and forest, plain banners without writing. Faded old-memory colors.
cuts.label: 1584年 小牧・長久手
cuts.image: A faded memory of a battle on a wide plain in Owari: armored horsemen and foot soldiers clashing among low hills and forest, plain banners without writing. Faded old-memory colors.

cuts.narration: 秀吉と家康の戦だ。馬の上から来る槍を受けるたび、火花が散った。
cuts.image_en: A faded memory on a wide grassy plain among low wooded hills in Owari: a battered sword clashing against a spear thrust down from a charging armored horseman, sparks and dust, plain banners without writing, no blood. Faded old-memory colors.
cuts.image: A faded memory on a wide grassy plain among low wooded hills in Owari: a battered sword clashing against a spear thrust down from a charging armored horseman, sparks and dust, plain banners without writing, no blood. Faded old-memory colors.

cuts.narration: どちらも、刀狩令の、わずか4〜5年前の戦だ。
cuts.tts_text: どちらも、かたながりれいの、わずか、よ、ごねんまえの戦だ。
cuts.image_en: A faded memory of a quiet battlefield at sunset after the fighting: broken spears, torn plain banners without writing and dropped swords scattered across trampled grass, crows in the red sky. No people. Faded old-memory colors.
cuts.label: 4〜5年前
cuts.image: A faded memory of a quiet battlefield at sunset after the fighting: broken spears, torn plain banners without writing and dropped swords scattered across trampled grass, crows in the red sky. No people. Faded old-memory colors.

cuts.narration: わしが追ったのは、猪だけだ。
わしらは、もう十分に斬った。仏の釘になるなら、それもよい。
わしが知っているのは、あの家の土間の冷たさと、畑への道だけだ。
cuts.image_en: The heap of swords in the storehouse at night, seen from a low angle, calm and silent, moonlight like a blessing over them. No people.
cuts.image: The heap of swords in the storehouse at night, seen from a low angle, calm and silent, moonlight like a blessing over them. No people.

cuts.narration: わしは決めた。釘になる前に、もう一度だけ、あの家を見たい。
cuts.image_en: The old plain uchigatana sword in a worn black scabbard slowly sliding out from the bottom of the heap of weapons in the moonlit storehouse. No people. Place the sword slightly right of center.
cuts.image: The old plain uchigatana sword in a worn black scabbard slowly sliding out from the bottom of the heap of weapons in the moonlit storehouse. No people. Place the sword slightly right of center.

cuts.narration: 夜ふけ。1本の刀が、刀の山から、するりと抜け出した。
cuts.image_en: Night. The old plain uchigatana sword in its worn black scabbard gliding out through a narrow gap under the wooden door of a storehouse into the moonlight, as if alive. No people. Place the sword slightly right of center.
cuts.label: 夜ふけ
cuts.image: Night. The old plain uchigatana sword in its worn black scabbard gliding out through a narrow gap under the wooden door of a storehouse into the moonlight, as if alive. No people. Place the sword slightly right of center.

cuts.narration: 蔵の戸のすき間を抜け、月明かりのあぜ道を、少しずつ進む。
cuts.image_en: A wide moonlit view of rice paddies at night, a tiny lone sword moving along the narrow raised path between the fields, fireflies, distant farmhouses. No people.
cuts.image: A wide moonlit view of rice paddies at night, a tiny lone sword moving along the narrow raised path between the fields, fireflies, distant farmhouses. No people.

cuts.narration: 足は無い。だが、夜のあいだだけなら、少しずつ動ける。
村の犬が、一度ほえた。刀は、草むらでじっと止まった。
cuts.image_en: A village dog barking in the dark beside a farmhouse fence while the old sword lies motionless hidden in tall grass in the foreground, moonlight. No people.
cuts.image: A village dog barking in the dark beside a farmhouse fence while the old sword lies motionless hidden in tall grass in the foreground, moonlight. No people.

cuts.narration: 通っているのは、持ち主が毎朝、畑へ通った道だ。猪を追って走った道でもある。
cuts.image_en: A narrow dirt path at night lined with old footprints and a small roadside stone Buddha, the sword moving past it, a single farmhouse ahead. No people.
cuts.image: A narrow dirt path at night lined with old footprints and a small roadside stone Buddha, the sword moving past it, a single farmhouse ahead. No people.

cuts.narration: この田は、前に役人が縄を張って、測っていった。わしも、持ち主の腰で見ていた。
cuts.image_en: Moonlit rice paddy at night with old wooden marker stakes still standing at its corners, the small lone sword in its black scabbard passing along the raised path beside them. No people. Place the sword slightly right of center.
cuts.image: Moonlit rice paddy at night with old wooden marker stakes still standing at its corners, the small lone sword in its black scabbard passing along the raised path beside them. No people. Place the sword slightly right of center.

cuts.narration: 1582年に始まった秀吉の検地だ。田1枚ごとに、耕す者の名が帳面に書かれた。
cuts.image_en: A faded memory in daylight at the edge of a rice paddy: a samurai official seated on a stool writing with a brush in a long bound ledger with only blurred unreadable brush strokes, the same lean peasant farmer in his thirties (sunburned face, short stubble, simple topknot, patched brown hemp kosode) kneeling before him with the old sword in a worn black scabbard at his belt, bowing his head. No readable writing. Faded old-memory colors. Place the main person slightly right of center.
cuts.label: 検地帳に名
cuts.image: A faded memory in daylight at the edge of a rice paddy: a samurai official seated on a stool writing with a brush in a long bound ledger with only blurred unreadable brush strokes, the same lean peasant farmer in his thirties (sunburned face, short stubble, simple topknot, patched brown hemp kosode) kneeling before him with the old sword in a worn black scabbard at his belt, bowing his head. No readable writing. Faded old-memory colors. Place the main person slightly right of center.

cuts.narration: 持ち主の家が見えた。土間の戸まで、あと十歩。
cuts.image_en: Night, low angle from tall grass: the small thatched farmhouse of the farmer just ahead under the moon, its wooden door a few steps away, the old sword in its worn black scabbard lying in the grass in the foreground. No people. Place the sword slightly right of center.
cuts.image: Night, low angle from tall grass: the small thatched farmhouse of the farmer just ahead under the moon, its wooden door a few steps away, the old sword in its worn black scabbard lying in the grass in the foreground. No people. Place the sword slightly right of center.

cuts.narration: そこで、また犬がほえた。今度は、すぐそばだ。刀は、息を殺して止まった。
cuts.image_en: Night beside the farmer's thatched house: a village dog standing stiff right next to the old sword hidden in the grass, ears up, barking toward it, moonlight, the house door just behind. No people. Place the sword slightly right of center.
cuts.label: すぐそばで犬
cuts.image: Night beside the farmer's thatched house: a village dog standing stiff right next to the old sword hidden in the grass, ears up, barking toward it, moonlight, the house door just behind. No people. Place the sword slightly right of center.

cuts.narration: 犬が去ると、刀は戸のすき間をくぐり、土間に、そっと横たわった。
cuts.image_en: Just before dawn, the old sword in its worn black scabbard slipping in through the gap under the wooden door of a small thatched farmhouse, the sky turning pale blue behind. No people. Place the sword slightly right of center.
cuts.image: Just before dawn, the old sword in its worn black scabbard slipping in through the gap under the wooden door of a small thatched farmhouse, the sky turning pale blue behind. No people. Place the sword slightly right of center.

cuts.narration: 朝。土間に下りた持ち主は、目を見開いた。差し出したはずの刀が、そこにある。
cuts.image_en: Early morning in a dim farmhouse entrance: the same lean peasant farmer in his thirties (sunburned face, short stubble, simple topknot, patched brown hemp kosode) frozen in shock with wide eyes and open mouth, staring down at the old sword in its black scabbard lying on the earthen floor, morning light through the door. His face in the vertical middle of the picture, with empty space above and below. Place the main person slightly right of center.
cuts.label: 刀が帰った
cuts.image: Early morning in a dim farmhouse entrance: the same lean peasant farmer in his thirties (sunburned face, short stubble, simple topknot, patched brown hemp kosode) frozen in shock with wide eyes and open mouth, staring down at the old sword in its black scabbard lying on the earthen floor, morning light through the door. His face in the vertical middle of the picture, with empty space above and below. Place the main person slightly right of center.

cuts.narration: 持ち主には、刀の声は聞こえない。誰かが返しに来たとしか思えない。
cuts.image_en: the same lean peasant farmer in his thirties (sunburned face, short stubble, simple topknot, patched brown hemp kosode) peering anxiously out of his door at the empty village road at dawn, holding the old sword behind his back. Place the main person slightly right of center.
cuts.image: the same lean peasant farmer in his thirties (sunburned face, short stubble, simple topknot, patched brown hemp kosode) peering anxiously out of his door at the empty village road at dawn, holding the old sword behind his back. Place the main person slightly right of center.

cuts.narration: 帰ったぞ。また、腰に差してくれ。
cuts.image_en: Close-up of the old sword in the farmer's rough hands, morning light glinting on the round iron guard, the moment feels warm and hopeful. Place the sword slightly right of center.
cuts.image: Close-up of the old sword in the farmer's rough hands, morning light glinting on the round iron guard, the moment feels warm and hopeful. Place the sword slightly right of center.

cuts.narration: 持ち主は、長いあいだ黙って、刀を見つめていた。
cuts.image_en: Morning in a dim farmhouse: the same lean peasant farmer in his thirties (sunburned face, short stubble, simple topknot, patched brown hemp kosode) sitting on the earthen floor holding the old sword in its black scabbard across his knees, silent and motionless, a thin beam of light through the door. Place the main person slightly right of center.
cuts.image: Morning in a dim farmhouse: the same lean peasant farmer in his thirties (sunburned face, short stubble, simple topknot, patched brown hemp kosode) sitting on the earthen floor holding the old sword in its black scabbard across his knees, silent and motionless, a thin beam of light through the door. Place the main person slightly right of center.

cuts.narration: うれしいのか、こわいのか。持ち主は、長いあいだ刀から目を離さなかった。
cuts.image_en: Close-up of the face of the same lean peasant farmer in his thirties (sunburned face, short stubble, simple topknot), eyes wet, torn between joy and fear, looking down at something in his hands. Place the main person slightly right of center.
cuts.image: Close-up of the face of the same lean peasant farmer in his thirties (sunburned face, short stubble, simple topknot), eyes wet, torn between joy and fear, looking down at something in his hands. Place the main person slightly right of center.

cuts.narration: わしを腰に差して、胸を張って村を歩く。刀狩が取ったのは、あの姿だった。
cuts.tts_text: わしを腰に差して、胸を張って村を歩く。かたながりが取ったのは、あの姿だった。
cuts.image_en: A warm faded memory: the same lean peasant farmer in his thirties (sunburned face, short stubble, simple topknot, patched brown hemp kosode) walking proudly through the village with the old sword at his belt, villagers greeting him. Place the main person slightly right of center. Faded old-memory colors.
cuts.image: A warm faded memory: the same lean peasant farmer in his thirties (sunburned face, short stubble, simple topknot, patched brown hemp kosode) walking proudly through the village with the old sword at his belt, villagers greeting him. Place the main person slightly right of center. Faded old-memory colors.

cuts.narration: そして、腰には差さず、古い布で、もう一度ていねいに包み直した。
cuts.image_en: the same lean peasant farmer in his thirties (sunburned face, short stubble, simple topknot, patched brown hemp kosode), kneeling on the farmhouse floor in morning light, carefully wrapping the old sword in faded indigo cloth again instead of putting it at his belt, glancing at the door. Place the main person slightly right of center.
cuts.image: the same lean peasant farmer in his thirties (sunburned face, short stubble, simple topknot, patched brown hemp kosode), kneeling on the farmhouse floor in morning light, carefully wrapping the old sword in faded indigo cloth again instead of putting it at his belt, glancing at the door. Place the main person slightly right of center.

cuts.narration: しまったのは、家のいちばん奥。納戸の長持の、底だった。
cuts.tts_text: しまったのは、家のいちばん奥。なんどのながもちの、底だった。
cuts.image_en: In a dark back storeroom of a farmhouse, the same lean peasant farmer in his thirties (patched brown hemp kosode, simple topknot) laying the cloth-wrapped sword at the bottom of a large wooden storage chest, a candle beside him. Place the main person slightly right of center.
cuts.image: In a dark back storeroom of a farmhouse, the same lean peasant farmer in his thirties (patched brown hemp kosode, simple topknot) laying the cloth-wrapped sword at the bottom of a large wooden storage chest, a candle beside him. Place the main person slightly right of center.

cuts.narration: それから一度も、持ち主は、刀を腰に差して歩かなかった。
cuts.image_en: The lid of a large wooden storage chest closing slowly in a dark storeroom, the last thin line of candlelight falling on the indigo cloth inside. No people.
cuts.label: 二度と差さない
highlight: 腰に差して歩かなかった
cuts.image: The lid of a large wooden storage chest closing slowly in a dark storeroom, the last thin line of candlelight falling on the indigo cloth inside. No people.

cuts.narration: 持ち主は納戸の戸を、音を立てないように、そっと閉めた。
cuts.tts_text: 持ち主はなんどの戸を、音を立てないように、そっと閉めた。
cuts.image_en: Night in a dim farmhouse: the same lean peasant farmer in his thirties (sunburned face, short stubble, simple topknot, patched brown hemp kosode) slowly sliding shut the wooden door of the dark back storeroom where the storage chest sits, his hand pressed flat on the door, eyes closed, a candle on the floor. Place the main person slightly right of center.
cuts.image: Night in a dim farmhouse: the same lean peasant farmer in his thirties (sunburned face, short stubble, simple topknot, patched brown hemp kosode) slowly sliding shut the wooden door of the dark back storeroom where the storage chest sits, his hand pressed flat on the door, eyes closed, a candle on the floor. Place the main person slightly right of center.

cuts.narration: わしは、家に帰れた。だが、あの姿は、もう帰ってこない。
cuts.image_en: Inside the dark closed wooden chest, the old sword wrapped in indigo cloth lying still, a tiny sliver of light through a crack. No people. Place the sword slightly right of center.
cuts.image: Inside the dark closed wooden chest, the old sword wrapped in indigo cloth lying still, a tiny sliver of light through a crack. No people. Place the sword slightly right of center.

cuts.narration: 本当の歴史でも、1642年、尾張藩は、町人と百姓に大刀と大脇差を禁じた。
cuts.image_en: An Edo-period town gate in Owari: a stern samurai official stopping a townsman and pointing at the long sword at his belt, the townsman bowing and removing it, other townspeople with only short knives watching. Faded old-memory colors. Place the main person slightly right of center.
cuts.label: 1642年 尾張藩
cuts.image: An Edo-period town gate in Owari: a stern samurai official stopping a townsman and pointing at the long sword at his belt, the townsman bowing and removing it, other townspeople with only short knives watching. Faded old-memory colors. Place the main person slightly right of center.

cuts.narration: 腰に長い刀を差して歩く姿は、少しずつ、武士だけの物になっていく。
cuts.image_en: Two Edo-period samurai walking down a town street with two swords at their waists, townspeople and farmers stepping aside and bowing. Faded old-memory colors.
cuts.label: 武士の印
cuts.image: Two Edo-period samurai walking down a town street with two swords at their waists, townspeople and farmers stepping aside and bowing. Faded old-memory colors.

cuts.narration: 気に入ったら、チャンネル登録をお願いします。
cuts.label: チャンネル登録

cuts.narration: では本当の歴史で、刀狩のあと、村から刀は消えたのか。
cuts.tts_text: では本当の歴史で、かたながりのあと、村から刀は消えたのか。
cuts.image_en: A peaceful Edo-period farming village in autumn, thatched houses, rice drying racks, a few villagers at work. Faded old-memory colors.
cuts.image: A peaceful Edo-period farming village in autumn, thatched houses, rice drying racks, a few villagers at work. Faded old-memory colors.

cuts.narration: 消えてはいない。歴史の辞典にも、民間の武器が無くなったわけではない、とある。
cuts.image_en: An old village storeroom where a farmer quietly lifts a sword and a spear out of a wooden chest, checking them, lantern light. Place the main person slightly right of center. Faded old-memory colors.
cuts.label: 武器は残った
cuts.image: An old village storeroom where a farmer quietly lifts a sword and a spear out of a wooden chest, checking them, lantern light. Place the main person slightly right of center. Faded old-memory colors.

cuts.narration: では、残った刀は使われたのか。江戸時代の百姓一揆は、およそ1430件。
cuts.image_en: A large crowd of Edo-period peasants in straw raincoats and hats marching on a country road carrying hoes, sickles, straw banners without writing and bamboo poles, no swords drawn. Faded old-memory colors.
cuts.label: 一揆 約1430件
cuts.image: A large crowd of Edo-period peasants in straw raincoats and hats marching on a country road carrying hoes, sickles, straw banners without writing and bamboo poles, no swords drawn. Faded old-memory colors.

cuts.narration: そのうち武器を持ち出したのは、1%ほどだったという。
cuts.image_en: Close-up of the rough hands of an Edo-period peasant gripping only a wooden hoe handle and a straw banner pole in a marching crowd, no blade anywhere, dust on the road. Faded old-memory colors.
cuts.label: 約1%
cuts.image: Close-up of the rough hands of an Edo-period peasant gripping only a wooden hoe handle and a straw banner pole in a marching crowd, no blade anywhere, dust on the road. Faded old-memory colors.

cuts.narration: 村の衆が、鍬や鎌を手に集まった夜も、長持の刀は、呼ばれなかった。
cuts.tts_text: 村のしゅうが、鍬や鎌を手に集まった夜も、ながもちの刀は、呼ばれなかった。
cuts.image_en: Night in a farming village: villagers with torches gathering in front of a farmhouse carrying hoes, sickles and bamboo poles, no swords, while through the open door the dark back storeroom with a closed wooden storage chest sits untouched. Place the chest slightly right of center.
cuts.image: Night in a farming village: villagers with torches gathering in front of a farmhouse carrying hoes, sickles and bamboo poles, no swords, while through the open door the dark back storeroom with a closed wooden storage chest sits untouched. Place the chest slightly right of center.

cuts.narration: それどころか1633年。肥後の新しい領主、細川忠利は、こう命じたという。
cuts.tts_text: それどころか1633年。ひごの新しい領主、ほそかわただとしは、こう命じたという。
cuts.image_en: A Japanese daimyo lord in his late forties in formal dark kamishimo, calm stern face, chonmage topknot, seated in a castle hall in Kumamoto and handing a blank written order to a kneeling retainer. No readable writing. Faded old-memory colors. Place the main person slightly right of center.
cuts.label: 1633年 肥後

cuts.narration: 庄屋は刀と脇差を持て。百姓は脇差を持て。持たない者には罰金を科す。
cuts.image_en: A village square in Higo: a samurai official reading a blank order aloud to village headmen with swords and peasants with short wakizashi at their belts, the peasants looking surprised at each other. No readable writing. Faded old-memory colors. Place the main person slightly right of center.
cuts.label: 脇差を持て
cuts.image: A village square in Higo: a samurai official reading a blank order aloud to village headmen with swords and peasants with short wakizashi at their belts, the peasants looking surprised at each other. No readable writing. Faded old-memory colors. Place the main person slightly right of center.

cuts.narration: 歴史学者の藤木久志さんが、刀狩を調べた本で紹介している例だ。
cuts.tts_text: 歴史学者のふじきひさしさんが、かたながりを調べた本で紹介している例だ。
cuts.image_en: A quiet study desk with an old open Japanese history book, stacks of old documents tied with string, a magnifying glass, warm lamp light. No readable writing. No people.
cuts.image: A quiet study desk with an old open Japanese history book, stacks of old documents tied with string, a magnifying glass, warm lamp light. No readable writing. No people.

cuts.narration: 長持の底で、刀は、村の人の話し声だけを聞いていた。
cuts.tts_text: ながもちの底で、刀は、村の人の話し声だけを聞いていた。

cuts.narration: 刀は、村にある。だが、誰も抜かない。わしの出番は、もう来ないのか。
cuts.image_en: Inside the dark closed wooden chest, the old sword wrapped in faded indigo cloth, a thin warm line of evening light leaking in through a crack in the lid. No people. Place the sword slightly right of center.
cuts.image: Inside the dark closed wooden chest, the old sword wrapped in faded indigo cloth, a thin warm line of evening light leaking in through a crack in the lid. No people. Place the sword slightly right of center.

cuts.narration: では、刀たちが釘になるはずだった大仏は、どうなったのか。
cuts.image_en: A gigantic wooden Great Buddha hall rising above the eastern hills of Kyoto in the late 16th century, crowds and ox carts on the road below, golden afternoon light.
cuts.chapter: 釘になるはずだった大仏
cuts.image: A gigantic wooden Great Buddha hall rising above the eastern hills of Kyoto in the late 16th century, crowds and ox carts on the road below, golden afternoon light.

cuts.narration: 場所は京都の東山、方広寺。秀吉が建てさせた大仏だ。
cuts.tts_text: 場所は京都のひがしやま、ほうこうじ。秀吉が建てさせた大仏だ。
cuts.image_en: Hideyoshi, standing proudly before the enormous Great Buddha hall under construction in Kyoto, pointing up at it, carpenters on scaffolding. Place the main person slightly right of center.
cuts.label: 方広寺
cuts.image: Hideyoshi, standing proudly before the enormous Great Buddha hall under construction in Kyoto, pointing up at it, carpenters on scaffolding. Place the main person slightly right of center.

cuts.narration: その大仏は、できあがった翌年に、倒れている。
cuts.image_en: The colossal wooden Buddha statue cracked and collapsed in pieces inside the great hall, dust hanging in shafts of light, monks staring in disbelief.
cuts.label: 翌年に倒れた
cuts.image: The colossal wooden Buddha statue cracked and collapsed in pieces inside the great hall, dust hanging in shafts of light, monks staring in disbelief.

cuts.narration: 京都市の年表では、木で造って漆を塗った大仏ができあがったのは1595年。
cuts.tts_text: 京都市の年表では、木で造ってうるしを塗った大仏ができあがったのは1595年。
cuts.image_en: The finished colossal golden-lacquered wooden Buddha glowing in its vast hall as monks and townspeople gather at its feet in celebration, incense smoke rising. Faded old-memory colors.
cuts.label: 1595年 木の大仏
cuts.image: The finished colossal golden-lacquered wooden Buddha glowing in its vast hall as monks and townspeople gather at its feet in celebration, incense smoke rising. Faded old-memory colors.

cuts.narration: その翌年、1596年。大きな地震が、京都と伏見を襲った。
cuts.image_en: A violent earthquake shaking Kyoto: wooden buildings swaying, roof tiles falling, people running in panic, dust in the air.
cuts.label: 1596年 大地震
cuts.image: A violent earthquake shaking Kyoto: wooden buildings swaying, roof tiles falling, people running in panic, dust in the air.

cuts.narration: 高さ18メートルあまりといわれる大仏が、大きく揺れて、崩れ落ちた。
cuts.image_en: Inside the vast dim Great Buddha hall during a violent earthquake: the colossal golden-lacquered wooden Buddha statue swaying, dust and pieces of gold leaf falling, tiny monks fleeing at its feet.
cuts.label: 揺れる大仏
cuts.image: Inside the vast dim Great Buddha hall during a violent earthquake: the colossal golden-lacquered wooden Buddha statue swaying, dust and pieces of gold leaf falling, tiny monks fleeing at its feet.

cuts.narration: 百姓の刀を釘にすると言って建てた大仏は、1年ほどで立っていられなくなった。
その後、秀吉の子の秀頼が、銅の大仏を建て直す。できあがったのは1612年。
cuts.tts_text: その後、秀吉の子のひでよりが、銅の大仏を建て直す。できあがったのは1612年。
cuts.image_en: A colossal seated bronze Great Buddha statue newly completed inside a rebuilt vast temple hall in Kyoto, dark metallic sheen, monks and townspeople bowing at its feet, incense smoke, warm light. Faded old-memory colors.
cuts.label: 1612年 銅の大仏
cuts.image: A colossal seated bronze Great Buddha statue newly completed inside a rebuilt vast temple hall in Kyoto, dark metallic sheen, monks and townspeople bowing at its feet, incense smoke, warm light. Faded old-memory colors.

cuts.narration: その銅の大仏も、1662年の地震で倒れ、寛永通宝という銭に変えられた。
cuts.tts_text: その銅の大仏も、1662年の地震で倒れ、かんえいつうほうという銭に変えられた。
cuts.image_en: A heap of small round bronze coins with square holes spilling across a wooden tray beside a broken piece of a giant bronze Buddha statue, lantern light. No readable writing. No people.
cuts.label: 寛永通宝
cuts.image: A heap of small round bronze coins with square holes spilling across a wooden tray beside a broken piece of a giant bronze Buddha statue, lantern light. No readable writing. No people.

cuts.narration: 1798年には大仏殿も焼けた。今、跡地には巨石の石垣が、国の史跡として残る。
cuts.image_en: A long row of gigantic old stones forming a massive stone wall along a quiet street in Kyoto, a few tiny visitors walking beside it, calm afternoon light. No readable signs.
cuts.label: 巨石の石垣
cuts.image: A long row of gigantic old stones forming a massive stone wall along a quiet street in Kyoto, a few tiny visitors walking beside it, calm afternoon light. No readable signs.

cuts.narration: 木の大仏も、銅の大仏も消えた。それでも石だけは、今も京都の東山に並んでいる。
cuts.tts_text: 木の大仏も、銅の大仏も消えた。それでも石だけは、今も京都のひがしやまに並んでいる。
cuts.image_en: Late afternoon in Kyoto: a close view of the gigantic old stones of the former Great Buddha temple wall, moss in the joints, long warm shadows, a single fallen leaf. No people.
cuts.image: Late afternoon in Kyoto: a close view of the gigantic old stones of the former Great Buddha temple wall, moss in the joints, long warm shadows, a single fallen leaf. No people.

cuts.narration: 江戸の世が続き、刀を差して歩く人は、武士だけになっていた。
cuts.image_en: A late Edo-period town street at sunset: samurai with two swords walking among townspeople and farmers who carry no swords. Faded old-memory colors.
cuts.chapter: 刀を差す人が消えた日
cuts.image: A late Edo-period town street at sunset: samurai with two swords walking among townspeople and farmers who carry no swords. Faded old-memory colors.

cuts.narration: 苗字を名乗り、刀を差す。それは原則として、武士だけに許されたしるしになった。
cuts.tts_text: みょうじを名乗り、刀を差す。それは原則として、武士だけに許されたしるしになった。
cuts.image_en: A proud Edo-period samurai in formal haori and hakama standing at the gate of his house with two swords at his waist, while a farmer with only a hoe bows deeply on the road before him. Faded old-memory colors. Place the main person slightly right of center.
cuts.label: 苗字帯刀
cuts.image: A proud Edo-period samurai in formal haori and hakama standing at the gate of his house with two swords at his waist, while a farmer with only a hoe bows deeply on the road before him. Faded old-memory colors. Place the main person slightly right of center.

cuts.narration: そして1876年3月28日。武士だった人からも、刀を外させる廃刀令が出る。
cuts.image_en: A former samurai in kimono slowly removing his two swords from his belt in front of his house, his face full of bitter emotion. Place the main person slightly right of center.
cuts.label: 1876年 廃刀令
cuts.image: A former samurai in kimono slowly removing his two swords from his belt in front of his house, his face full of bitter emotion. Place the main person slightly right of center.

cuts.narration: 刀を差してよいのは、大礼服を着る時と、軍人や警察官などの制服の時だけになった。
cuts.tts_text: 刀を差してよいのは、たいれいふくを着る時と、軍人や警察官などの制服の時だけになった。
cuts.image_en: Early Meiji era: a uniformed Western-style police officer with a sabre at his hip standing on a town street, while a former samurai in plain kimono with an empty sash walks past him, looking down. Faded old-memory colors. Place the main person slightly right of center.
cuts.label: 制服の時だけ
cuts.image: Early Meiji era: a uniformed Western-style police officer with a sabre at his hip standing on a town street, while a former samurai in plain kimono with an empty sash walks past him, looking down. Faded old-memory colors. Place the main person slightly right of center.

cuts.narration: 刀狩令から288年。刀を差して歩く人は、日本の道から消えた。
cuts.tts_text: かたながりれいから288年。刀を差して歩く人は、日本の道から消えた。
cuts.image_en: Early Meiji-era Japan: a busy town road with people in kimono and a few in Western coats and hats, a rickshaw passing, not one person carrying a sword, evening light. Faded old-memory colors.
cuts.label: 288年
cuts.image: Early Meiji-era Japan: a busy town road with people in kimono and a few in Western coats and hats, a rickshaw passing, not one person carrying a sword, evening light. Faded old-memory colors.

cuts.narration: 1603年の江戸幕府から、1867年の大政奉還まで、江戸時代はおよそ265年。
cuts.tts_text: 1603年の江戸幕府から、1867年のたいせいほうかんまで、江戸時代はおよそ265年。
cuts.image_en: A grand symbolic view of Edo castle town at dawn under a wide sky, the castle keep and countless tiled roofs stretching to the horizon, a long highway leading away. No people. Faded old-memory colors.
cuts.label: 江戸時代 約265年
cuts.image: A grand symbolic view of Edo castle town at dawn under a wide sky, the castle keep and countless tiled roofs stretching to the horizon, a long highway leading away. No people. Faded old-memory colors.

cuts.narration: 288年は、江戸時代をまるごと1つ入れても、まだ余る長さだ。
cuts.image_en: A symbolic wide view of a long old Japanese highway stretching from a feudal castle town in the distance to a Meiji-era town with telegraph poles in the foreground, sunset sky. No people. Faded old-memory colors.
cuts.image: A symbolic wide view of a long old Japanese highway stretching from a feudal castle town in the distance to a Meiji-era town with telegraph poles in the foreground, sunset sky. No people. Faded old-memory colors.

cuts.narration: 長持の底で、刀は外の足音を聞いた。腰の刀が鳴る音は、もう混じらない。
cuts.tts_text: ながもちの底で、刀は外の足音を聞いた。腰の刀が鳴る音は、もう混じらない。
cuts.image_en: Early Meiji era, seen from inside a dark farmhouse storeroom: a closed wooden storage chest in the foreground, and through the slatted window the village road outside where former samurai and farmers walk past, not one of them wearing a sword, evening light. Place the chest slightly right of center.
cuts.image: Early Meiji era, seen from inside a dark farmhouse storeroom: a closed wooden storage chest in the foreground, and through the slatted window the village road outside where former samurai and farmers walk past, not one of them wearing a sword, evening light. cuts.narration: 小さな足音が、長持の横を走りぬけていく。その腰にも、刀は無い。
cuts.tts_text: 小さな足音が、ながもちの横を走りぬけていく。その腰にも、刀は無い。
cuts.image_en: Early Meiji era, inside a dim farmhouse storeroom at sunset: a small farm child in a simple kimono running past the closed old wooden storage chest, bare feet on the wooden floor, nothing at the child's waist, warm light through a slatted window, the chest in the foreground. Place the chest slightly right of center.

cuts.narration: あなたなら、どこで歴史を変える？コメントで教えてください。

Place the main person slightly right of center.

cuts.narration: それでは、また次の世界線で。

style: 劇画寄りの歴史漫画。太く力強い主線、陰の濃い塗り、行灯や夕日の暖かい色。表情は大げさに。横長の画面で1枚の絵に1つの場面（コマ割り・枠を付けない）。人物は真ん中より少し右。有名なアニメ・漫画・ゲームの絵柄に似せない。絵の中に文字を入れない
avoid: 絵の中の文字・数字・ロゴ・看板の字、コマ割り、枠、吹き出し、血・けが
style_en: Japanese historical gekiga manga illustration: bold confident ink outlines, heavy dramatic shadows, rich warm colors of paper lanterns and sunset, painted backgrounds of feudal Japan, intense exaggerated facial expressions. Hand-drawn look, never glossy or 3D. Original style that does not resemble any famous anime, manga or video game.
